selection.reason: Higher-detail SAM 2.1 large tracking on a 680x544 analysis crop, restored to the full source canvas. Additional source-coordinate prompts suppress the dark background fixture adjacent to the woman's hip over frames 333–420. Foreground points preserve clothing, hands and feet; no temporal averaging. Corrective predictions are applied only to the reviewed hip region: the fully corrected masks degraded motion-blurred knee details, so the higher-detail full tracking pass is retained elsewhere. At frame 386 the full tracking prediction has the verified cleaner hip boundary, so it overrides the local correction.

cleanup.method: 8-connected components; remove area <=32 source pixels only when >20 pixels from main person

pinholes.method: Fill enclosed holes <=12px only when median source RGB differs from foreground rim by <=18 RGB units

processing.downsampling: area coverage (Pillow BOX); opaque interiors; RGB retained independently

instanceEncoding.filter: area coverage; divide by union coverage when sampling
